swap_risks: CRITICAL PACKAGE MISMATCH: TPS613221ADBVR uses SOT-23-5 (5-pin, DBV) while TPS63001DRCR uses VSON-10 (10-pin, DRC); PCB footprint redesign is mandatory.

CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (SW vs VOUT), Pin 2 (GND vs SW), Pin 3 (NC vs GND), Pin 4 (VOUT vs SW), Pin 5 (NC vs VIN), Pin 6 (NONE vs EN), Pin 7 (NONE vs PS), Pin 8 (NONE vs VIN), Pin 9 (NONE vs GND), Pin 10 (NONE vs FB). Soldering TPS63001DRCR onto a TPS613221ADBVR footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.
Exposed thermal pad/tab mismatch (SOT-23-5: NONE vs VSON-10: GND); PCB land pattern & solder-mask change required.

CRITICAL TOPOLOGY DIFFERENCE: TPS613221ADBVR is a boost converter whereas TPS63001DRCR is a buck-boost converter; power-stage architecture, inductor placement, and startup behavior differ fundamentally.

CAUTION CURRENT RATING BASIS: TPS613221ADBVR specifies 1200 mA (switch current limit Isw, p.5) vs TPS63001DRCR 1200 mA (continuous Iout, p.1). Remember boost Iout,max is strictly less than Isw due to duty-cycle scaling.
CAUTION THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA differs by 75% (TPS613221ADBVR: 189.7 °C/W p.4 vs TPS63001DRCR: 46.8 °C/W p.4); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
engineering_verdict: TPS613221ADBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) and TPS63001DRCR (Texas Instruments, VSON-10) are NOT pin-to-pin drop-in compatible (Level 3 PCB Layout Change Required) due to package/footprint mismatch; pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (SW vs VOUT), Pin 2 (GND vs SW), Pin 3 (NC vs GND), Pin 4 (VOUT vs SW), Pin 5 (NC vs VIN), Pin 6 (NONE vs EN), Pin 7 (NONE vs PS), Pin 8 (NONE vs VIN), Pin 9 (NONE vs GND), Pin 10 (NONE vs FB); exposed pad / thermal tab net mismatch. Key datasheet deltas: topology is boost (sync) vs buck-boost (sync), switching frequency is 1600 kHz (p.9) vs 1500 kHz (p.5), rated current is 1200 mA (p.5) vs 1200 mA (p.1), typical inductor is 2.2 µH (p.4) vs 2.2 µH (p.1), and Iq is 6.5 µA (p.5) vs 41 µA (p.5). Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.3), thermal margin (θJA 189.7 vs 46.8 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
